comparison.objective: Pack divided lunchbox compartments, seat the lid, and close four latches.
comparison.physical_skill: Divider insertion, categorized placement, lid alignment, and repeated latch actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Divider, packets, lid, and all four latches are released within their pose tolerances.
comparison.reason: Multi-part packing and closure do not test a calibrated stop or countertorque.
